title: Order API 500 surge caused by database connection saturation
resolutionSummary: Reduced connection leak from a recently deployed transaction path, increased pool observability, and rolled back the slow query change.

title: Order write latency increase from lock timeout
resolutionSummary: Removed a conflicting batch update and adjusted lock acquisition order for order and inventory reservation updates.

title: Payment authorization timeout increase
resolutionSummary: Shifted eligible traffic to the secondary provider and restricted retry fan-out while verifying idempotency-key persistence.

title: Payment event backlog after provider recovery
resolutionSummary: Paused automatic replays, isolated failed authorization events, and replayed only idempotent messages after manual approval.

title: Inventory sync consumer lag and stock mismatch
resolutionSummary: Identified poison messages, moved them to the dead-letter queue, and replayed validated inventory updates in partition order.

title: SMS delivery delay caused by provider rate limit
resolutionSummary: Applied provider-specific backoff, prioritized transactional messages, and delayed non-critical campaign messages.

title: Connection acquisition delay after slow order transaction deployment
resolutionSummary: Rolled back the transaction change, terminated long-running order writes, and restored connection acquisition latency to baseline.

title: Order API 500 increase after database failover
resolutionSummary: Recycled stale pooled connections after database failover and verified datasource validation settings before restoring normal traffic.

title: Retry amplification increased database pressure
resolutionSummary: Reduced automatic retry fan-out, isolated transient failures, and allowed database connection pressure to recover before restoring retry limits.

title: Slow query regression increased order transaction duration
resolutionSummary: Reverted the query-plan regression, added the missing index, and confirmed shorter transaction duration and lower pool utilization.

title: Order transaction lock amplification during batch update
resolutionSummary: Paused the conflicting batch update, reduced retry pressure, and reordered writes to remove repeated lock contention.

title: Inventory reservation latency delayed order commits
resolutionSummary: Isolated the slow inventory reservation path, reduced synchronous wait time, and restored normal order commit duration.

title: Payment authorization delay caused order request timeout
resolutionSummary: Adjusted payment timeout handling, prevented duplicate retry fan-out, and restored order processing after provider latency normalized.

title: Order service exception burst after release
resolutionSummary: Rolled back the faulty release, grouped the dominant stack traces, and confirmed the database and downstream services were healthy.
